输入 tag，空格分隔，例如 scenery sky: Enter tags separated by spaces, e.g. scenery sky
输入 tag、user:画师 ID，或粘贴画师、作品链接: Tags, user:artist ID, or an artist or work link
输入关键词，或 creator:服务/作者 ID，例如 creator:patr: Keywords, or creator:service/creator ID, e.g. creator:patreon/123456
实际发给站点的查询: The query actually sent to the site
站点一次能搜的 tag 数有限，「{filter}」在本地逐页筛选，加载会慢一些: The site limits how many tags one search can use, so “{filter}” is filtered locally page by page, which loads more slowly. Gold accounts and above can search more tags directly.
没有找到符合条件的图片。「近期热门」只包含最近两天上传的图，可以换个排序再试。: No matching images found. “Trending” only covers images uploaded in the last two days, so try another sort.
没有找到符合条件的图片。可以减少 tag 或放宽分级再试。: No matching images found. Try fewer tags or more ratings.
带受限 tag 的图，Danbooru 只对 Gold 及以上等级的账号开放原图: Danbooru only offers originals of images with restricted tags to Gold accounts and above.
站点没有开放这张图的原图，画师被封禁或图片已下架时会这样。: The site doesn't offer this original. This happens when the artist is banned or the image was taken down.
暂时无法统计，可以直接开始: Couldn't get a count right now. You can start anyway.
站点没有给出总数（条件较复杂时会这样），可以直接开始: The site didn't report a total (this happens with complex searches). You can start anyway.
张，留空表示全部下载: images; leave empty to download all
张，按「{sort}」取排在前面的，留空表示全部下载: images, the top ones by “{sort}”; leave empty to download all
已在图库里的图会自动跳过。下载在后台进行，可以随时在「下载」里暂停或取消。: Images already in your library are skipped. Downloads run in the background, and you can pause or cancel them anytime in Downloads.
不下载，只下载以后的新图: Skip them and only download new images from now on
现在也下载，最多{input}张: Download them now too, up to {input}
最多下载多少张已有的图: Maximum number of existing images to download
以后按设定的间隔检查，有新图就自动下载。: The search is checked at the interval you choose, and new images download automatically.
订阅按上传先后找新图，不使用「{sort}」排序。: Subscriptions look for new images by upload time and don't use the “{sort}” sort.
关掉窗口后会在后台继续，可以在「设置 → 通用」里修改。: Checking continues in the background after you close the window; you can change this in Settings → General.
点一张图查看详情: Select an image to see its details
没有符合条件的图片。可以减少 tag 或放宽分级再试。: No matching images. Try fewer tags or more ratings.
在「发现」里下载的图片会出现在这里。: Images you download in Discover will show up here.
文件不在记录的位置，可能已被移动或删除。可以重新下载到图片位置。: The file isn't where it was saved; it may have been moved or deleted. You can download it again to the images location.
{title}：图片文件移到{trash}，还能从那里找回；图库记录和缩略图一起: {title}: the image files go to the {trash}, where you can still recover them. Their library records and thumbnails are deleted.
{title}：文件留在原处，只删除图库记录。: {title}: the files stay where they are, and only their library records are deleted.
按设定的间隔检查新图并自动下载。关掉窗口后也会在后台继续，可以在「设置 → 通用: Checks for new images at the interval you set and downloads them automatically. Keeps running in the background after you close the window; you can change this in Settings → General.
在「发现」里搜索后点「订阅」，以后有新图会自动下载。: Search in Discover and click Subscribe, and new images will download automatically.
发给站点的查询: The query sent to the site
这个订阅已经在检查中: This subscription is already being checked
订阅都在检查中，或者没有启用的订阅: All subscriptions are already being checked, or none are enabled
以后不再检查「{title}」的新图。已经下载的图和进行中的下载都保留。: “{title}” will no longer be checked for new images. Downloaded images and downloads in progress are kept.
只移除这条任务，已下载的图片不受影响: Removes only this task; downloaded images are kept
下载的图片保存在「设置 → 存储」里的图片位置。: Downloaded images are saved to the images location in Settings → Storage.
{status}。一次下载一个任务，其余按加入顺序排队。: {status}. One task downloads at a time, and the rest wait in the order they were added.
在「发现」里勾选图片，或者点「下载全部结果」，任务会排在这里。: Select images in Discover or click Download all, and the tasks will line up here.
读取失败，请稍后再试。: Couldn't load them. Try again later.
界面语言，以及软件在后台怎么运行。订阅要按时检查，需要软件一直开着。: Language and how the app runs in the background. Subscriptions are only checked on schedule while the app is running.
界面、提示信息、{tray}菜单和系统通知使用的语言。: Used for the interface, messages, the {tray} menu and notifications.
订阅检查和下载不中断，从{tray}里的图标重新打开窗口。: Subscription checks and downloads keep going. Reopen the window from the icon in the {tray}.
关掉窗口就退出，订阅只在软件打开时检查。: Closing the window quits the app, and subscriptions are only checked while it's open.
关闭窗口后会在后台继续运行: The app will keep running after you close the window
关闭窗口时会退出软件: Closing the window will quit the app
登录系统后自动在后台启动，不弹出窗口，订阅照常按时检查。: Starts in the background when you log in, without opening a window, so subscriptions are checked on schedule.
登录系统后会自动在后台启动: The app will start in the background when you log in
切换到发现、图库、订阅、下载: Switch to Discover, Library, Subscriptions or Downloads
勾选或取消勾选当前这张: Select or deselect the current image
发现页：下载当前这张，有勾选时下载勾选的: Discover: download the current image, or the selected ones
图库：删除当前这张，有勾选时删除勾选的: Library: delete the current image, or the selected ones
记录下载任务、订阅检查和出错的情况，文件超过 2 MB 会换新的。: Records downloads, subscription checks and errors. A new file is started once it passes 2 MB.
主题和跟随系统，改动立即生效。: Themes and following the system appearance. Changes apply right away.
系统切换深浅色时自动换主题：深色用{dark}，浅色用{light}。开启后点主: Switches themes when the system changes between light and dark: {dark} for dark, {light} for light. While this is on, clicking a theme replaces the one for its mode.
保存前会先用填写的账号访问一次站点。API Key {where}。: Accounts are checked against the site before they're saved. API keys are {where}.
加密后存在设置文件里: stored encrypted in the settings file
不登录也能浏览和下载。Gold 以上等级的账号一次能搜更多 tag（Gold 6: You can browse and download without signing in. Gold accounts and above can search more tags at once (6 for Gold, 12 for Platinum), and only they can download originals of images with restricted tags.
登录 Danbooru 网页后，在「My Account」页面的 API Key: Sign in on the Danbooru website and create one under API Key on the My Account page.
Gelbooru 的接口必须填写账号才能使用。: Gelbooru's API only works with an account.
登录 Gelbooru 网页后，在「My Account → Options」页: Sign in on the Gelbooru website; it's under API Access Credentials at the bottom of My Account → Options.
不登录也能搜索和下载公开图片。填写账号和 API Key 后，接口会使用登录身份: You can search and download public images without signing in. Add an account and API key when you want requests to use your signed-in identity.
登录 e621 后，在「Account」页面创建 API Key。: Sign in to e621 and create an API key on the Account page.
Rule34.xxx 的接口必须填写 User ID 和 API Key 才能搜: Rule34.xxx requires a User ID and API key for searches.
登录 Rule34.xxx 后，在账号设置页生成 API Access Cred: Sign in to Rule34.xxx and create API Access Credentials in the account options.
不登录也能搜全年龄作品、下载原图，但按 tag 搜最多翻 10 页。看 R-18: Without signing in you can search all-ages works and download originals, but tag searches stop after 10 pages. R-18 works need you to sign in.
已在浏览器打开 Pixiv，请登录后粘贴 PHPSESSID: Pixiv is open in your browser. Sign in, then paste the PHPSESSID.
在软件窗口里登录 Pixiv，登录好后这里会自动完成。: Sign in to Pixiv in the app window. This finishes by itself.
推荐在浏览器里登录 Pixiv，再粘贴 Cookie 里的 PHPSESSID；: Signing in in a browser and pasting PHPSESSID is recommended. The in-app window uses the current proxy.
登录窗口未能使用当前代理，已回退直连: The login window couldn't use the current proxy and switched to a direct connection.
切换后，已经保存的 API Key 会一起搬过去。: Keys you've already saved move over when you switch.
交给系统的{keychain}保管，最安全，推荐使用。: Kept in {keychain}. The most secure option, and the recommended one.
用这台电脑专属的密钥加密后存在设置文件里；文件被复制到别的电脑上解不开，换电脑需: Encrypted with a key unique to this computer and kept in the settings file. A copy of the file can't be decrypted on another computer, so you'll need to enter the keys again after switching computers.
API Key 已改为加密保存在设置文件里: API keys are now stored encrypted in the settings file
API Key 已改为保存在系统{keychain}里: API keys are now stored in {keychain}
代理用于搜索、预览图和原图下载，保存后立即生效。: The proxy is used for searches, previews and original downloads, and applies as soon as you save.
使用系统设置里的代理，没设置就直接连接: Use the proxy from the system settings, or connect directly if none is set
总是直接连接站点: Always connect to the sites directly
代理设置已保存，之后的请求立即使用: Proxy settings saved and used for all new requests
图片、数据库、软件数据和缓存各自的位置。修改时可以把已有内容一起移过去。: Where images, the database, app data and the cache are kept. When you change a location, you can move what's already there.
图库索引、下载任务和订阅: Library index, download tasks and subscriptions
缩略图和预览图，删掉后浏览时会重新下载: Thumbnails and previews, downloaded again as you browse if deleted
，修改后重启生效: ; changes take effect after a restart
有位置修改要重启后才生效。: Some location changes take effect after a restart.
位置设置本身保存在 {file}，这个文件的位置不能修改。: The location settings themselves are saved in {file}, which can't be moved.
{label}会在重启后移到新位置: Will move {label} to the new location after a restart
{title}：新位置需要是空文件夹。: {title}: the new location has to be an empty folder.
{title}：新位置需要是空文件夹。{label}正在使用，下次启动时再移动。: {title}: the new location has to be an empty folder. Since {label} is in use, it moves at the next launch.
新下载的图片存到新位置，已有图片还在原来的文件夹里。: New downloads go to the new location, and existing images stay in the old folder.
使用新位置的数据库: Use the database at the new location
新位置里已有数据库就直接使用，没有就新建一个空的。: A database already at the new location is used as is; otherwise a new, empty one is created.
新位置从空开始: Start fresh at the new location
设置恢复默认，旧数据留在原处。: Settings go back to their defaults, and the old data stays where it is.
缓存会在浏览时重新下载。: The cache is downloaded again as you browse.
重新加载一般就能恢复。下载和订阅在后台照常进行，不受影响。: Reloading usually fixes it. Downloads and subscriptions keep running in the background.
{n} 张图，按来源分成文件夹，封面是最近下载的几张。: {n} {n|image|images}, sorted into folders by source. Covers show the latest downloads.
可以按所选图片原来的上一级文件夹创建画师或分类，也可以全部放在自定义导入根目录。: Use each selected image's parent folder as an artist or category, or put everything in the custom import root.
上一级文件夹作为画师或分类 ID: Use the parent folder as the artist or category ID
所有图片直接放在自定义导入目录: Put all images directly in the custom import folder
这些图都没有这类 tag，可以换一种分组方式。: None of these images have tags of this kind. Try another grouping.
在这里按 tag 筛选，空格分隔，-tag 表示排除: Filter here by tags separated by spaces, -tag to exclude
来源勾选两个以上平台（聚合搜索）时才能按平台筛选: Select two or more sites to filter by site
每个平台各建一个下载任务，上限对每个平台分别计算。: Each site gets its own download job, and the limit applies to each one.
每个平台各建一个订阅。: Each site gets its own subscription.
输入用户名后，在 X 的媒体页面里收集图片: Enter a username, then collect images from the X media page
采集窗口会使用自己的登录状态，登录 X 后打开用户的 Media 页面；只收集图: The capture window keeps its own sign-in state and opens the user's Media page on X. Images are collected; videos aren't added yet.
X 媒体窗口已打开，页面滚动时会自动收集图片: The X media window is open. Images are collected as the page scrolls.
开始采集后，X 页面加载到的图片会出现在这里。: Images loaded by X appear here after capture starts.
